cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says: is a rule on state data in force.
cells.note: The minister said in May and June 2026 that state data should be held only in Gabon and that a national data centre would open (GAB-006, GAB-001), so stage 2. Law 027/2023 (GAB-005) keeps sensitive data in Gabon but dates from July 2023, before the window, and no later source states it, so not 3.
